messages:
support-engineer: Escalation from ACME Corp — their chat widget is intermittently cutting off after long idle periods. Customer says last event is partial (truncated JSON) and client reconnects but receives duplicate tokens billed.

sre-oncall: Thanks — do we have a request id or example trace?

support-engineer: Request-id: req_0a1b2c3d4e. They sent this repro curl:```curl -N -H "Accept: text/event-stream" "Authorization: Bearer <token>" "https://api.redwood.com/v1/stream"```

customer: When the widget idles ~60s and then we trigger a new message, the stream either ends mid-event or we see a FIN and then the client reconnects and gets partial JSON. Happens behind AWS ALB + Cloudflare in front.

eng-runtime: Any traces? can you paste the tail of the server logs around req_0a1b2c3d4e?

support-engineer: Pasted sample logs:
```
[2026-03-15T21:12:34Z] req=0a1b2c3d4e stream open session=abc
[2026-03-15T21:13:38Z] req=0a1b2c3d4e keepalive heartbeat sent
[2026-03-15T21:14:40Z] req=0a1b2c3d4e write error: write tcp 10.0.1.5:443->10.0.2.7:51832: use of closed network connection
[2026-03-15T21:14:40Z] req=0a1b2c3d4e stream closed remote FIN
```

netops: That looks like the ALB is closing the connection after its idle timeout. What's the ALB idle timeout configured to? default is 60s.

customer: ALB idle timeout is set to 60s. We thought Cloudflare's keepalive would prevent it but apparently not.

eng-runtime: Observed behavior matches ALB half-close + backend still sending small chunk: if client is idle beyond idle_timeout, ALB may send RST or FIN on backend connection. With HTTP/2 between ALB and backend we sometimes see RST_STREAM that causes partial last chunk on client.

sre-oncall: Can we reproduce locally? steps to repro from support: 1) put Cloudflare in front (optional) 2) ALB with default 60s 3) start SSE stream, let idle >60s, then emit a ~1k event.

eng-runtime: I reproduced with nginx -> ALB -> client. Summary of root cause: ALB enforces idle timeout and may close long-lived idle connections even if app later sends a chunk; the connection close races with write and can cause partial transfer. Cloudflare can coalesce TCP segments making partial JSON arrive.

support-engineer: Customer sees duplicate billing on reconnect (client retries and server replays last tokens). We should recommend idempotency + dedupe, but also fix the streaming stability.

netops: Immediate mitigations:
- Increase ALB idle timeout to >= 300s for this customer's target connections (supports long-polling/SSE).
- Ensure backend sends regular heartbeat chunks < 60s (we suggest every 25s). Example server heartbeat:```data: {"type":"hb"}

```
- If using Cloudflare, enable "Origin Keep-alive" and disable HTTP/2 proxying to backend (CF -> ALB), or set CF to forward HTTP/1.1 to avoid h2 RST_STREAM behavior.

eng-runtime: Runtime-side changes we can push: set Transfer-Encoding: chunked and flush after each write; ensure low-level socket SO_KEEPALIVE + application heartbeat. Also set response header `X-Accel-Buffering: no` for nginx proxies and `proxy_buffering off;` in nginx config for SSE endpoints. Example nginx snippet:
```
location /v1/stream {
  proxy_set_header Connection "";
  proxy_buffering off;
  chunked_transfer_encoding on;
  proxy_read_timeout 360s;
}
```

sre-oncall: Also important: ALB has an idle timeout and a deregistration delay. If target gets drained it might close sockets; ensure target group dereg delay isn't racing with connection activity.

support-engineer: Customer asked for a short repro script we can run from laptop to observe partial chunk behavior. I recommended:
```bash
# server: emit one event, sleep 70s, then emit 2nd event
python3 -m http.server --bind 0.0.0.0 8080 &
# (use netcat or a tiny Flask SSE app)
# client: curl -N to endpoint and watch for truncated second event after 60s when ALB idle closes
```

customer: We captured tcpdump on our side. After ~60s we see FIN from ALB to the backend, then backend sees EPIPE on write. The client sometimes gets only partial event payload.

eng-runtime: Next operational triage plan:
1) Ask customer to temporarily raise ALB idle timeout to 300s and confirm.
2) If they can't, deploy heartbeat sending every 20-25s from the app (small SSE comment chunk).
3) Add server-side write retry/durable buffering to avoid billing duplicate tokens on reconnect (idempotency key per response chunk).
4) We will add a runtime config doc to recommend `proxy_buffering off` + `proxy_read_timeout` + `chunked_transfer_encoding` for SSE paths.

netops: I've created a quick ALB tweak runbook and added an internal note: modify target group's connection termination behavior and increase idle timeout for specific target group.

deploy-bot: Deploy queued: sse-heartbeat-sample-config -> staging (started)

support-engineer: Customer is trying increasing the ALB timeout now, will update in ~15m. thanks all. :thumbsup:

sre-oncall: Also tracking: open a follow-up ticket to audit other customers using SSE behind ALBs and Cloudflare. Might be systemic.

support-engineer: Update (last): customer raised idle timeout to 300s — no further truncation observed on their end during 2h test. Closing for now but we should publish a KB with recommended config.

customer: Confirmed fixed. Thanks for the quick turnaround. :tada:
